backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining media uploads, live sessions, user profiles, comments, and access‑controlled operations using storage and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report linking features to source files, components, and test IDs for camera permission handling in live preview.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of all major frontend components and pages.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment configuration for Internet Identity, canister IDs, network selection, and deployment settings.
frontend/docs/ic-mainnet-deployment.md: Documentation outlining prerequisites and steps for deploying OmniStream to the IC mainnet.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme variables and light/dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint loading the React app and setting metadata and root container.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: List of approved IC domains for the frontend canister.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React entrypoint configuring hash‑based routing, splash screen timing, theme provider, and route definitions.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared layout wrapper with navbar, footer, backend availability banner, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Sign‑in/sign‑out control using Internet Identity with login retry logic and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/BackendUnavailab: Displays an error banner when the backend is unreachable, with URL diagnostics and reload options.
Shows comments for a media item and provides an authenticated form to submit new comments with timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/CreatePostForm.t: Form for creating an image post with file selection, preview, upload progress, and caption input.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Generic empty-state component showing an icon, title, and description.
frontend/src/components/FloatingActionBu: Authenticated floating action button that expands to navigation shortcuts for creating various content types.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with branding, navigation links, community info, and a dynamic attribution link.
frontend/src/components/LiveCameraPrevie: Handles camera and microphone permission preflight and displays a live camera preview with capture and switch-camera controls.
frontend/src/components/NavBar.tsx: Navigation bar component showing links, authentication state, and user info.
frontend/src/components/PollCard.tsx: Displays a poll with voting UI, percentages, and authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Renders a post with author info, timestamp, image, and caption.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting the user to enter and save a display name.
frontend/src/components/ShortCard.tsx: Card preview for a short video with thumbnail, title, and duration.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Fullscreen splash screen showing a branded image during loading.
frontend/src/components/UploadForm.tsx: Media upload form handling file selection, duration validation, and upload progress.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Video preview card showing thumbnail, duration, title, and date.
frontend/src/components/VideoPlayer.tsx: Custom video player with play controls, seeking, volume, and fullscreen support.
frontend/src/components/ViewerTimer.tsx: A timer component that counts down between user-defined start and end times and triggers a callback when finished.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, stored identity restoration, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating media, profiles, live sessions, and other backend data via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles with custom CSS variables and light/dark theme definitions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the personalized feed of videos and shorts and triggers profile setup if needed.
frontend/src/pages/LiveDetailsPage.tsx: Shows details for a live session, including owner controls to end the session and status information.
frontend/src/pages/LivePage.tsx: Page to browse active live sessions and start a new session with a setup form and camera preview.
frontend/src/pages/PollsPage.tsx: Displays community polls and provides an authenticated form to create new polls.
frontend/src/pages/PostsPage.tsx: Shows a feed of posts sorted by date and allows authenticated users to create new posts.
frontend/src/pages/ShortsPage.tsx: Lists short vertical videos with a grid layout and shows an empty state when none exist.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx: Handles media upload, requiring authentication and optional profile setup before using the upload form.
frontend/src/pages/WatchPage.tsx: Loads and plays a video or short by title, showing metadata, errors, and related actions like re-uploading.
frontend/src/types/poll.ts: Defines TypeScript types for polls, including poll structure and identifiers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining dark mode, content paths, extended theme colors, fonts, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: JSON describing the project's current state, requirements, architecture notes, known issues, and existing features for the OmniStream video-sharing site.
